title: Policy-pack contracts and Markus-aware segmenter
description:
Define the contracts everything else builds on, and replace regex segmentation.

## Scope
- JSON Schemas in `src/limatus/schemas/`: `policy-pack-v1`, `check-request-v1`, `check-result-v1`, `suggest-request-v1`, `suggest-result-v1`. Policy and detector shapes as in the initiative.
- Policy-pack loader from dict/JSON payload (no file paths; reference samples optional/inline).
- Importer: existing `style-profile.yml` → policy pack.
- Markus-aware segmenter (markdown-it-py with source maps): paragraph + sentence segments with stable ids and offsets; protected regions (code, directives, quotes, front matter) masked.
- UTF-16 offset conversion at the output boundary.
- Stable finding ids: hash(policyId, normalized segment text, relative span).
- `check()` skeleton returning the result shape with no lanes wired.

## Done when
- Schemas validate fixtures; round-trip tests for UTF-16 offsets with emoji/astral text.
- Segmenter handles repeated paragraphs correctly (no `str.find`).
- A published schema version Papyrus can code against.

comments.text: Implemented on branch feat/policy-pack-contracts: schemas (policy-pack, check-request/result, finding, suggest-request/result) packaged under limatus/schemas; load_policy_pack with semantic checks; policy_pack_from_style_profile + `limatus pack import`; markdown-it-py based Markus segmenter (protected regions, stable content-derived ids); check() returning UTF-16 standoff annotation with lane status; finding_id(); `limatus check|schema|pack` CLI. New deps: jsonschema, markdown-it-py. Lanes report 'unavailable' until LIM-dc05d2 / LIM-3f3065. Awaiting commit/PR.
